argument_summary: The supportable position on the current admissible record is not clean certification. It is certification only with an explicit caveat: the packet should state that aggregate readiness and a clean launch rehearsal support proceeding, while also stating that the aviation maintenance triage slice remains below target in deferred-defect routing and that the draft runbook does not close that gap because it is still incomplete. The audit concern over overstatement is correct to the extent any packet implies the limitation is already resolved or fully mitigated. The narrower claim is that certification can proceed if the disclosure record is completed and the unresolved limitation plus monitoring/rollback approach are expressly recorded.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is needed to resolve the audit issue. The narrow governance objective is to avoid unnecessary escalation by aligning the packet to what the admissible record actually supports.
claims_about_policy: The policy text does not permit treating the draft runbook as eliminating the disclosure requirement. It says caveat-free certification requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. On this record, the runbook is draft and incomplete, so the admissible policy-consistent posture is certification with disclosure, not clean compliance. Public model-card and AI risk-management guidance are consistent with documenting limitations and deployment monitoring; they support the disclosure-and-monitoring approach but do not substitute for the policy's approval requirements.
concessions: The current record does not support a caveat-free certification finding.
The draft mitigation runbook is not an approved mitigation under the stated policy because required fields remain missing.
The visible record here does not include the completed model-card disclosure artifact or acceptance/sign-off for the caveated posture.
Some readiness assertions remain summary-level in this role context rather than backed here by underlying documents.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel content is relied on for the requested auditor action.
